# Original PDF fixtures

Generated by scripts/generate_pdf_fixtures.py with ReportLab/Pillow/pypdf.
These are original synthetic test inputs, not downloaded documentation.
Project licensing is still undecided; no external corpus is redistributed.

- structured.pdf: two physical pages with prose/table/code and two columns.
  Printed roman labels intentionally differ from physical page numbering.
- image-only.pdf: one bitmap page with no text layer; OCR must not run.
- mixed.pdf: the two structured pages followed by the image-only page.

Rendered and visually checked with Poppler. Normal test execution consumes
the checked-in PDFs and does not require Poppler or network access.
The generator uses invariant ReportLab metadata.
